neighbours.label: need to urinate or defecate: bowel movements, bladder urgency, using the toilet
fire: Potty training goes faster when toddlers learn to tell you before they need to go.
Fiber helps keep each bowel movement soft and regular.
Patients with an overactive bladder feel a sudden urge to urinate many times a day.
Always wash your hands after using the toilet and before cooking.
The medicine may cause loose stools and frequent trips to the bathroom.
Older dogs sometimes have accidents indoors when they can't hold their bladder.
Constipation means having fewer than three bowel movements a week.
He woke up twice in the night needing to pee.
quiet: Toddlers learn to tell you when they feel hungry or tired before naptime.
Fiber helps keep blood sugar steady after each meal.
Patients with asthma feel a sudden tightness in the chest during exercise.
Always wash your hands after gardening and before cooking.
The medicine may cause dizziness and frequent headaches in the afternoon.
Older dogs sometimes have stiff joints when the weather turns cold.
Insomnia means having trouble falling asleep at least three nights a week.
He woke up twice in the night with a dry cough.

notes: Card top examples are all bowel/urinary urgency or restroom use; logit effect promotes bathroom/toilet/GI tokens. Near misses keep the health/hygiene register.
